purpose: Clinical research to improve public health planning.
question: Compare active antidepressant use in adults with depression.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Antidepressant = ATC code starting with N06AB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: adults with depression, % with an active antidepressant, one decimal.
